title: Applied ML Weekly Notes - 2026-06-23
content:
Weekly applied-ml notes (Mon 2026-06-23)
Owner: Maya Patel
Quick context: catch-up notes from standups + sync with serving-runtime and optimize teams. Focus this week: 4-bit quantization experiments, eval suite additions for hallucination metrics, onboarding procedure tweaks for v2 models.

---

Standup / meeting highlights:
- Mon sync (30m) with serving-runtime / infra: discussed kernel fallback behavior for q4_0 runtimes. Action: Noah to add logging hooks to capture failed kernel selection occurrences (>1% threshold).
- Tuesday deep-dive on evals: Aisha presented initial hallucination-rate metric using QA-parity dataset (internal). Found unexpected spike for conversational prompts with long context (>1024). Need to separate tokenization-induced truncation from model behavior.
- Onboarding triage (Wed): PR #418 (model onboarding repo) passed basic checks but failed integration test on Dedicated due to missing kv-cache warmup step in the runner. Liam to patch runner to include warmup request sequence.

Quantization experiments (primary work this sprint)
- Goals: get stable 4-bit (q4_0/q4_k_mixed) configs for Llama2-derived checkpoints with <5% generation-quality delta on our eval set, and 30-40% CPU/GPU memory reduction.
- Setup: experiments running on dev-gpu-pool (A100/40GB), batch sizes 1/2/4, seq-lens 256/1024/2048. We use the same tokenization and prompt templates as production to avoid covariate shifts.
- Key runs and results (rough):
  - base fp16 -> baseline perplexity: 12.1 (eval set)
  - q4_0 static quant -> perplexity: 13.6 (+12%), latency -6% p95, mem -42%
  - q4_k_mixed (KV mixed precision) -> perplexity: 12.8 (+5.8%), latency -9% p95, mem -48%
  - q4_0 + small FP16 residuals (hot layers) -> perplexity: 12.3 (+1.7%), mem -40%
- Interpretation: q4_k_mixed looks promising for cost/latency tradeoff; small FP16 residuals further reduce quality gap. Recommend continuing with q4_k_mixed + hot-layer FP16 for Canary on dedicated.
- Open questions: what threshold of perplexity delta is acceptable per customer SLA? Product input needed (tagging for product-hosted-api).

Evals & metrics updates
- Added hallucination-rate metric (binary on a per-answer basis) to eval harness. Current baseline (fp16) hallucination-rate: 4.1% on internal QA-parity set; q4_k_mixed: 6.8%. Need to investigate where errors concentrate (multi-hop reasoning prompts vs. single-shot fact recall).
- Plan: add breakdown by prompt type and by token-length buckets. Also start logging answer provenance confidence score (from our scoring head) to correlate with hallucination.
- Regression alerting: wire hallucination-rate and perplexity into Optimize alerts. Action: Aisha to open ticket to add metric -> alert mapping (JIRA- AM-876).

Model onboarding notes
- v2 model onboarding checklist updates (draft):
  - metadata: model_id, architecture, tokenizer_name, max_seq_len, recommended_quant_profiles
  - test-suite: batched generation, kv-cache warmup, streaming behavior, function-calling smoke test
  - perf-profiles: p50/p95 latency across seq-lens, memory footprint, token-cost estimate
- Issue observed: some community checkpoints use modified tokenizer special tokens -> leads to truncated outputs. Add explicit tokenizer compatibility step to onboarding.
- Integration tests failing on Dedicated because runner doesn't perform the canonical warmup sequence. Proposed fix: new "warmup_mode" config that triggers 3 sequential prefix-queries to populate KV cache before measuring perf. (Liam assigned)

Blockers / Risks
- Kernel selection failures for q4_k paths cause occasional fallbacks to fp16 with increased latency; need more visibility (Noah).
- SLI risk: if hallucination-rate increases beyond 5% on canary, will block rollout; need product to pick acceptable thresholds and rollback policies.
- Resource contention: dev-gpu-pool saturated next week due to infra maintenance windows. May delay large-scale evals.

Action items (owners)
- Noah Wright: add kernel failure logging + metric (due 2026-06-26).
- Liam Chen: implement runner warmup_mode and patch onboarding PR #418 (due 2026-06-25).
- Aisha Rahman: add hallucination breakdown and wire alerts to Optimize (open JIRA AM-876, due 2026-06-27).
- Maya Patel (me): prepare canary experiment plan for q4_k_mixed + hot-layer FP16, including rollout gating and rollback criteria (due 2026-06-29).

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Revisit tokenizer compatibility checklist and add automated token-length diff test in onboarding pipeline.
- Reach out to product-hosted-api (cc: Priya) for threshold discussion; capture in onboarding doc.
- Keep short notes in this doc as experiments progress; move final version to Confluence once canary starts.

Appendix: quick logs / snippets
- Quick shell snippet used for perf runs: 
  for seq in 256 1024 2048; do python run_perf.py --model $MODEL --quant q4_k --batch 1 --seq_len $seq --warmup 3; done
- Eval harness command used: pytest tests/eval_harness.py::test_hallucination --runs 200 --model $MODEL --tokenizer $TK

End of notes.

(Informal: lots of moving parts; focus this week on visibility + onboarding fixes so we can safely trial q4_k_mixed on Dedicated.)
